userMessage: what is the Merge node for?
rationale: Regression coverage for INS-1394. A product question about a node must be answered from the n8n-docs tool, which is always loaded. Before the fix, two skills told the model to load n8n-docs via load_tool first. That tool resolves only deferred tools, so the call returned not_found, the model fell back to search_tools, and it answered from the node parameter definitions instead of the docs. Sizing: the n8n-docs action is not pinned, because lookup and search+read are both correct; a load_tool call is not forbidden, because it now returns already_loaded and the agent proceeds straight to n8n-docs; a nodes call is not forbidden, because a correct answer can read the node definition as well as the docs. Capability-gap finding: this case reds on the default eval model (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6), which answers the question from parametric knowledge and calls no tool at all (0/3 trials, zero tool calls). That is a real behaviour gap independent of INS-1394 - n8n product answers should come from n8n's own docs, because model memory goes stale on node specifics. It passes on anthropic/claude-opus-5. Adding "based on the n8n docs" to the prompt makes tool use much more likely on weaker models, which is why the red is a model-personality finding rather than a routing bug.
